title: Franchise vs. Promotion/Relegation Comparator
description: Eight-dimension comparison of closed franchise model (NFL/NBA/MLB) vs. open promotion/relegation model (EPL/Bundesliga): competitive balance, investment incentives, revenue distribution, fan culture, player markets, and governance. Embedded 2024 league financial data.
data_vintage: Deloitte Football Money League 2024; Forbes team valuations 2024
regulatory_citations: Fort & Quirk (1995), Pay dirt: The business of professional team sports
Szymanski (2003), The Economic Design of Sporting Contests
